notes: Only 1 run per configuration, so the ± values show spread across the 3 prompts, not run-to-run variance.

8 of 11 checks pass in both configurations (personas, epics, 'so that', priorities, IDs, out of scope, persona consistency), so they don't separate the skill from the baseline. Claude already writes decent story structure without the skill.

The 3 checks that do separate them: (1) the questionnaire offers concrete options with a recommendation, the format AskUserQuestion needs; (2) every story has Given/When/Then (baseline: 44/46, 25/35, 21/23); (3) assumptions and open questions are in the stories file itself, not only in questionnaire.md, which matters when the spec is written from the file.
Scope: the skill produced 24/24/20 stories; the baseline produced 46/35/23. The skill's 8-25 target keeps v1 tight, while the baseline tends to over-scope (e.g. 10 epics for the loyalty program).
Cost: the skill adds about 29s and 5k tokens per run (+19% time, +11% tokens), mostly from reading the repo and writing the interview log.
